item.title: Supply, demand to dominate market dynamics in 2026
item.description: While broader economic risks remain, market dynamics are being driven by supply, demand and income generation, rather than macro headlines, said Pat Haskell, head of the municipal bond group at BlackRock.

item.title: Oppenheimer hires former Stern Brothers managing director Vien Le
item.description: Le will work out of Oppenheimer's Los Angeles office and will focus on California while also supporting clients across the west, the release noted.

item.title: DOT focused on cutting regulations
item.description: U.S. Department of Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy doubled down on cutting DEI and climate change related policies amid conjecture about federal funding levels.

item.title: Trump touts economy, unveils AI 'ratepayer pledge' in State of the Union address
item.description: The "ratepayer protection pledge" requires tech companies to cover the costs of powering data centers.

item.title: Midwest Democratic governors aim to soften sting of Trump policies
item.description: From Illinois to Wisconsin to Michigan, Democratic governors outlined plans to ameliorate budget crunches made worse by Trump administration policies.

item.title: Columbus planning $500M affordable housing bond
item.description: After Columbus, Ohio, voters gave the green light in November, Mayor Andrew Ginther this month released his plan for the affordable housing bond proceeds.

item.title: Corpus Christi to pursue initial contract for desalination project
item.description: The Texas city is reviving a seawater desalination project as it faces a water supply crisis that has impacted its bond ratings.

item.title: DOJ lawsuit claims UCLA ignored workplace antisemitism
item.description: The Trump administration filed the lawsuit Tuesday ahead of UC Regents plans to price $1.93 billion in revenue bonds.

item.title: Munis a tad firmer out long, 'positive view' of market
item.description: There is a positive view of the muni market in the long-term due to a mix of attractive tax-adjusted yields and a generally favorable credit backdrop, said Cooper Howard, director of fixed income research and strategy at Charles Schwab.

item.title: KBRA and Fitch downgrade Chicago
item.description: KBRA and Fitch Ratings downgraded Chicago's general obligation bonds to BBB-plus from A-minus on Wednesday, and both kept their rating outlooks at negative.
